principle_violations.reason: The sum method is determining the area logic for specific shapes which should be the responsibility of each shape class, not the AreaCalculator class.
principle_violations.suggestion: Move area calculation logic to their respective shape classes (Circle and Square) by implementing a method like area().

principle_violations.reason: The sum method in AreaCalculator needs modification every time a new shape type is introduced. This violates the open/closed principle as it is not open for extension but rather requires changes.
principle_violations.suggestion: Define an area method on each shape class so that the AreaCalculator can simply iterate over shapes and call shape.area(), making it open to new shapes without modification.
